crossRefs.note: and God’s lamp hadn’t yet gone out, and Samuel had laid down in Yahweh’s temple where God’s ark was,
Samuel lay until the morning, and opened the doors of Yahweh’s house. Samuel was afraid to show Eli the vision.
the king said to Nathan the prophet, “See now, I dwell in a house of cedar, but God’s ark dwells within curtains.”
But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple…
One thing I have asked of Yahweh, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in Yahweh’s house all the days of my life…
Yahweh’s voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, “Glory!”

people.name: Eli
people.line: High priest and judge of Israel at Shiloh

people.name: Hannah
people.line: The mother of the prophet Samuel.

people.name: Shiloh
people.line: Israelite sanctuary and assembly point during the judges' period

translations.web: So Hannah rose up after they had finished eating and drinking in Shiloh. Now Eli the priest was sitting on his seat by the doorpost of Yahweh’s temple.
translations.bsb: So after they had finished eating and drinking in Shiloh, Hannah stood up. Now Eli the priest was sitting on a chair by the doorpost of the temple of the LORD.
translations.kjv: So Hannah rose up after they had eaten in Shiloh, and after they had drunk. Now Eli the priest sat upon a seat by a post of the temple of the LORD.
translations.asv: So Hannah rose up after they had eaten in Shiloh, and after they had drunk. Now Eli the priest was sitting upon his seat by the door-post of the temple of Jehovah.
